Method of Attack: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) that copies itself to %AppData% and %UserProfile%, creates autostart entries, downloads and executes software, executes commands, remotely uses webcams, deletes files, enables Remote Desktop Services and VNC for remote access, logs keystrokes, steals Firefox and Chrome passwords
Attack Vector: Malspam campaign using fake WebEx meeting invites with Cisco open redirect URLs that lead to downloading a malicious webex.exe executable
Indicators of Compromise: URL: http://secure-web.cisco.com/ redirecting to malicious sites
Shortcut in Startup folder launching MusNotificationUx.vbs
